customers.usage_stats: Image workspace: 39 unique users (down from 42, -7%). Voxel art generator: 14 unique users (down from 20, -30%). Total images generated: 1080 (down from 1652, -35%). Total voxel models generated: 150 (up from 67, +224%). Image workspace generation time: 7.5 (up from 5.3, +42%). Generation time top 10 users: 6.5 (up 91%).

company_lowlights.description: Image workspace is confusing to new users; difficult to learn without explanation.
company_lowlights.impact: Barrier to adoption; lower user engagement.

product_updates.description: Upgraded image workspace to be ~3x faster with same quality.
product_updates.impact: Significantly improved processing speed of the tool for all users.

product_updates.description: Complete 3D model generator upgrade, reducing polygon count to ~20% of prior level.
Experimented with $12 plan for 4 hours of generation time, 2.5x more popular than $30 plan.
product_updates.impact: Lower-priced plan more attractive for new users.

notes: 3D usage and model generation increased, while image generation and workspace usage declined. Key usability issue identified with image workspace complexity for new users. Cash position and burn remain strong for small SaaS operation.
